newsitem.title: USA: Health Images files for 2.5 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Health Images files for 2.5 million shares.

text.p: Health Images Inc said Friday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 2.5 million common shares.
After the offering, the outstanding shares will total 13,977,364 common, the filing said.
The company granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 375,000 additional common shares. The sale will be made through Smith Barney Inc.
The Atlanta, Ga., company will use the proceeds to retire a portion of outstanding indebtedness and fund working capital.
Health Images is provider of diagnostic imaging services and an independent operator of magnetic resonance imaging in the United States.
